create_table_detection_model: create a TableTransformerForObjectDetection model for detecting tables in images with bounding boxes
build_table_transformer_encoder_decoder: build a TableTransformerModel encoder-decoder to extract hidden states from table images
run_object_detection_inference: run object detection inference with TableTransformerForObjectDetection to get class logits and predicted bounding boxes
train_table_detection_with_labels: train TableTransformerForObjectDetection by passing pixel values and labels to compute classification and bounding box losses
build_mlp_prediction_head: build a TableTransformerMLPPredictionHead multi-layer perceptron to predict normalized bounding box coordinates
